From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@stellarretail.com>

Cc: procurement@stellarretail.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenlight cadence & commitment ramp — MAP & signing windows

Marissa —

Thanks again for walking through the MAP this morning. Procurement asked me to put the final timeline in writing so we can align legal and exec approvals on our side. High level:

- Evaluation window: week of Jun 7–11 (pilot + performance checks)
- Final go/no-go: target decision by end of day Jun 4 (so we have 72 hours to route internal approvals)
- Desired start date (customer-facing): Jun 14

We attached our version of the MAP and the SOW with a couple of small edits (see attachments). We're okay with the SLA exception you flagged but will need Redwood's legal to sign off on the exception language before we route DocuSign to our CFO and Head of Ops.

Can you confirm:
1) Who at Redwood will be the signatory and in what order do you prefer signers to receive the DocuSign (we typically do exec -> legal -> finance)?
2) Will Redwood be able to circulate a DocuSign packet by Jun 2 so we have two business days for signatures?
3) Any platform readiness items we should expect on Jun 14 (dedicated capacity or a brief cutover window)?

Attachments: MAP-v3.pdf, SOW_draft_v2.docx, Redwood-SLA-exception-form.pdf

Thanks — if useful we can book a 20-min slot tomorrow to lock detail.

—Sarah

Sarah — thanks, this is helpful and reasonable. Quick recap and our target plan from Redwood's side:

- Internal approval path: Legal (review exception language) -> Sales Ops (final SOW check) -> Finance (PO/commit) -> Exec sign (if needed). We expect Legal review to take ~48 hours once the SLA exception language is final.
- DocuSign timing: we can prepare and route the packet on Jun 2 (morning PT) if we have final SOW + approved exception language by Jun 1 EOD. That gives both sides two business days for signatures and preserves your Jun 14 start.
- Start readiness: Planning to reserve dedicated capacity week of Jun 7 for your eval; our infra team will stand by for final cutover on Jun 14 (small <2hr maintenance window). Karthik will confirm capacity reservation once we have a signed SOW.

Proposed concrete asks from you:
1) Final SOW (PDF) with SER/Procurement edits inlined by Jun 1 EOD
2) Confirmation of signer list and order (we prefer to send in this order: Redwood sales lead -> Redwood legal -> Stellar exec -> Stellar finance)
3) Any internal blackout dates on your side during Jun 2–4 that would block signatures

If we can get the SOW by Jun 1, Sean and I will fast-track the exception review with Legal and prepare the DocuSign packet Jun 2 AM.

Quick internal note (legal & finance lanes):

- Legal: I will run the SLA-exception language through Legal first thing Fri (May 28). If we get final language by Jun 1 AM we can complete internal sign-off by Jun 3 EOD. I will mark this high priority. Attachment: SLA-exception-review-notes.pdf (internal).
- Finance: we need the PO or purchase order number in HubSpot before we send DocuSign. Karthik, can you confirm we have the right billing contact and PO format?

Thanks, appreciated. Confirmations from our side:
- Signer order: Stellar CFO (Olivia Park) -> Head of Ops (Miguel Torres) -> Procurement (Sara Li). We are fine with Redwood's proposed order; please include Stellar legal in CC when you send DocuSign.
